from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
           for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    # The clue marks are segments of parallel diagonals; use their orientation
    # to determine whether the repeated output bands follow r+c or c-r.
    choices = []
    for fn in (lambda r, c: r+c, lambda r, c: c-r):
        groups = {}
        for r, c, v in pts:
            groups.setdefault(fn(r, c), []).append(v)
        coherence = sum(max(Counter(vs).values()) for vs in groups.values())
        choices.append((coherence, fn))
    coord = max(choices, key=lambda item: item[0])[1]
    bands = [(coord(r, c), v) for r, c, v in pts]
    # The smallest modular period consistent with every observed stripe is
    # the repeating color motif. Clues determine all phases in these tasks.
    period = next(p for p in range(1, h+w+1)
                  if all((a-b) % p != 0 or va == vb
                         for i, (a, va) in enumerate(bands)
                         for b, vb in bands[i+1:]))
    phase = {a % period: v for a, v in bands}
    return [[phase[coord(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(h)]
